title: Smiling College Graduate at UCLA, 1966 California B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A radiant young woman beams with joy at her college graduation ceremony, wearing a traditional academic mortarboard, dark gown, white collar, and an orchid corsage pinned to her robe. In the background stands the distinctive Romanesque Revival architecture of Royce Hall at the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA), with fellow graduates and guests mingling in the courtyard on a bright California day. The photo's right border features a photo lab processing stamp reading 'MAR • 66'.
